en: I brought bread from the shop.
I didn't bring the phone with me.
You brought milk from the market.
You didn't bring your key.
You (f.) brought a gift for dad.
You (f.) didn't bring the juice with you.
He brought coffee from the café.
He didn't bring his pen.
She brought tea with her from Fas.
She didn't bring her bag.
We brought fruit to my aunt.
We didn't bring the money with us.
You (pl.) brought the kids with you today.
You (pl.) didn't bring the books with you.
They brought the medicine from the pharmacy.
They didn't bring their car.
I bring the newspaper every morning.
I don't bring money with me.
You bring the kids from school.
You don't bring your book.

lat: katjibi l-khodra mn s-suq kul jem3a
ar: كتجيبي الخضرة من السوق كل جمعة
en: You (f.) bring vegetables from the market every Friday.
You (f.) don't bring lunch with you.
He brings bread from the bakery.
He doesn't bring the kids with him.
She brings water from the spring.
She doesn't bring the books with her.
We bring honey from the village.
We don't bring food with us.
You (pl.) bring the sweets for Eid.
You (pl.) don't bring fruit with you.
They bring the books from the library.
They don't bring anything with them.
I'm going to bring my brother from the airport.
I'm not going to bring the computer with me.
You're going to bring juice and water.
You're not going to bring the gift tomorrow.
You (f.) are going to bring the cake with you tomorrow.
You (f.) are not going to bring your brother with you.

lat: ghadi yjib l-flus mn l-banka ghedda
ar: غادي يجيب الفلوس من البنكة غدا
en: He's going to bring the money from the bank tomorrow.

lat: ma ghadish yjib baba m3ah ghedda
ar: ما غاديش يجيب بابا معاه غدا
en: He's not going to bring dad with him tomorrow.

lat: ghadi tjib jellaba jdida mn fas
ar: غادي تجيب جلابة جديدة من فاس
en: She's going to bring a new jellaba from Fas.
She's not going to bring the books today.

lat: ghadi njibu l-bettikh mn s-suq ghedda
ar: غادي نجيبو البطيخ من السوق غدا
en: We're going to bring watermelon from the market tomorrow.
We're not going to bring the dog with us.
You (pl.) are going to bring the camera with you.

lat: ma ghadish tjibu l-flus m3akum ghedda
ar: ما غاديش تجيبو الفلوس معاكم غدا
en: You (pl.) are not going to bring the money with you tomorrow.
They're going to bring their ball tomorrow.
They're not going to bring tea with them.
